message.reasoning: The user says "billing date?" They likely want to know what their billing date is. According to policy: The billing date is shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to “Next invoice”. It does not shift month to month even though months have different lengths; a billing date of the 31st bills on the last day of a shorter month. Also monthly plan is invoiced on same day of month as subscription started or last renewed. So answer: explain where to find billing date and how it works. Provide short answer.
